summary: Refined the parent configuration question's discriminator now that its cadence half is measured in both directions: the negative control shows the gap absent when the snapshot already covers the change, so the discriminator keeps only what remains unmeasured — commit-tracking stores backed by production storage rather than the in-memory stores used in every measurement, and whether their staging semantics change when the recovered commit index reaches a configuration entry. No evidence, comparison or conclusion changed; the run's records (eight questions with retained receipts, nine behavior entries, and explicit counterevidence and limits) stand as submitted.
